description: CodeStack applies explicit Java writing conventions and targeted SQL, JPA and MyBatis mistake prevention to the current task.

interface.shortDescription: Task-scoped Java and persistence writing rules
defaultPrompt: Use $code-standards to apply the relevant CodeStack rules to this Java change or review.
interface.longDescription: One skill selects English Java, shared SQL data-access, JPA and MyBatis references from the current module and actual call paths. It covers multiline Javadoc, comment language, production/test construction boundaries, hidden per-item queries, bounded loading and framework-specific pitfalls. No runtime, hooks, separate agents or project configuration. Native loading, implicit selection and task outcomes require separate host evidence.
